BiblicalUsage: Kesulloth is a town in Issachar, near Jezreel, named in the tribal allotment. Joshua 19:18 says their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the small towns of the allotment are as much God's doing as the great cities, and he named them one by one.
